analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($52,935) above SMA5 ($51,976), below SMA20 ($61,372) and SMA50 ($81,377): confirming short-term weakness and medium-term downtrend.
· Significantly below SMA100 ($99,389) and SMA200 ($112,433): indicating very weak long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (16.5%) + current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (32.5→38.8) + exiting oversold and continuing sideways in neutral zone: confirming lack of direction.
· MACD histogram trajectory (3.0720→233.3870) + improving: suggesting potential bottoming, but trend reversal signal is weak.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near middle band $61,372) + band width 63.34%: entering a period of reduced volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($51,065): located above 5-day low and Pivot S1 ($36,675).
· Swing resistance ($65,285): located below 20-day high ($83,815).
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (No Higher Low, No Lower High): indicating continued sideways consolidation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.07x): suggesting moderate reliability of price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + entry conditions not met, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
